title: BoostBlocks
description: Target Blocks with a Gold Presureplate on top Boost you in the Air
body:
![Target BLock with Presure Plate on Top](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c83e675a7aac1afefd2c84a755c92d08745e310d.png)

If you place a Presure Plate on a Target Block you get a Boost Block

![Shift Right on a Boost Block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2b1290e6090dff4cf9aa51799b01eaf56cc32e5c.png)

If you then SHIFT + Click on a Boost Block, the managing GUI opens.

The rest of the Plugin is Work in Progress.

If you have problems, you can ask me on Discord: ToBiobis
